report.answer: Low-level streaming (SSE parsing) lives in src/core/streaming.ts (Stream class, Stream.fromSSEResponse, _iterSSEMessages), which is invoked by src/internal/parse.ts:24-39 whenever a request is made with stream:true, converting the raw fetch Response into an async-iterable Stream. Public API methods that route into it include client.responses.create()/retrieve() and client.chat.completions.create() (both overloaded to return APIPromise<Stream<...>> when body.stream is true, in src/resources/responses/responses.ts and src/resources/chat/completions/completions.ts), plus higher-level helpers responses.stream() → ResponseStream (src/lib/responses/ResponseStream.ts) and chat.completions.stream()/runTools() → ChatCompletionStream / ChatCompletionStreamingRunner (src/lib/ChatCompletionStream.ts, src/lib/ChatCompletionStreamingRunner.ts), as well as beta assistants' runs.stream() → AssistantStream (src/lib/AssistantStream.ts), all of which wrap core.Stream.

verified.summary: src/internal/parse.ts routes any request with options.stream=true through Stream.fromSSEResponse (or a custom __streamClass) to build the streamed body.
responses.create()/retrieve() are overloaded to return APIPromise<Stream<ResponseStreamEvent>> when stream:true, calling this._client.post/get with stream: body.stream ?? false.

chat.completions.create() is overloaded similarly for Stream<ChatCompletionChunk>; completions.stream() delegates to ChatCompletionStream.createChatCompletion; runTools() delegates to ChatCompletionStreamingRunner when body.stream is set.
responses.stream() delegates to ResponseStream.createResponse (src/lib/responses/ResponseStream.ts), a higher-level EventStream wrapper over core Stream.
